title: Cycle Sizing Framework — rapid staffing triage & scope-slice guidance
creator: Asha Mehta
description: A lightweight, repeatable framework the PM team will use each cycle to size available capacity, run rapid staffing triage, and decide scope-slices for OKR-aligned initiatives. This ticket captures the template, decision matrix, and communication playbook for stakeholders (eng leads, design, product ops, and GTM). The goal is to reduce last-minute scope churn, make trade-offs explicit, and provide a single source of truth for what will be shipped in the cycle.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page Cycle Sizing template published in Confluence and linked in the cycle kickoff
Decision matrix completed for at least three active initiatives (runtime perf, Console UX, Dedicated capacity controls)
Staffing commitments recorded for ENG/DES/RESEARCH and flagged changes routed to Growth & Customer Success
A published scope-slice catalogue with 'must', 'should', 'could' buckets for each initiative
Post-cycle retrospective section added to template to capture actual vs planned velocity and reasons for scope changes
milestones: Publish template and run a mock sizing exercise — 2026-03-04
Formalize staffing commitments and freeze cycle scope — 2026-03-11
Retrospective template added for next cycle — 2026-03-26
risks: Over-optimistic velocity estimates from feature teams leading to mid-cycle scope cuts
Unanticipated incidents (SLO breaches) that consume dedicated capacity
Insufficient engagement from small teams who rely on shared platform engineers
Misalignment between OKR priority and commercial urgency resulting in reprioritization
